answer: An copycat running 45 aliases thus needs 38 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in whisper, expire in hollow, and ember lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3281 identities would post 4407 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
